angle: Most-aware owner, already mid-onboarding. Each patch replaces something we can't stand behind with a firm, true promise: his details are in, we prepare and review, and we email him when we need his OK. The click ceiling is set for his trade and gives no number. Two things I couldn't do. First, I have no file access, so I couldn't read src/lib/bot/prompts.ts or src/lib/google-ads/ad-claims-guard.test.ts, and I couldn't list or patch any "15 ₪" lines in them. Someone with file access needs to grep both files for "15 ₪" and send me the customer-facing lines for patching. Strings that only appear inside test assertions should stay as they are. Second, I assumed the substring in docs/copy/google-ads-r2-final-candidate-2026-11-12.txt matches landingCopy.generated.ts byte for byte, and str.replace will fail if it doesn't. In the terms (A), I kept the paragraph's formal legal tone on purpose, because a terms document needs it. The guide-question answer that sends the owner to the chat stays as is.
